definitions.ask: Should enclosing-checkout repo resolution apply to the whole `bob plugins` family?
definitions.why: list and sync disagreeing about the repo from the same cwd is a worse trap than the original bug.

choices.label: list, bare default, and sync all resolve the same repo from the cwd, so they never disagree
only sync resolves from the cwd; list keeps env/default resolution and may name a different repo

definitions.ask: When the repo-refresh `git pull` fails, should sync fall back to `git fetch`?
definitions.why: the command already chose network by not passing --no-pull; fetch is the safe subset of pull.

choices.label: refresh remote refs without touching the worktree so refusal remedies name the landed build
keep pull-or-nothing; a dirty linked worktree leaves remote refs stale and remedies generic
